observations.body: Christ’s love and death reorder how people are known. Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences. Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.
